sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "scanenvironment"."zoneref" AS e, "sites"."guardhint" AS g, AVG("scanenvironment"."imgcount") AS m1 FROM "scanenvironment" JOIN "sites" ON "sites"."zoneregistry" = "scanenvironment"."zoneref"  GROUP BY "scanenvironment"."zoneref", "sites"."guardhint"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v"), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m1" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: average of images taken per sites within sites.guardhint
gap to the all average of average of images taken (all level)
rank within the group by average of images taken, keep the top 3

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "scanpointcloud"."arcref" AS e, "projects"."fundflux" AS g, AVG("scanpointcloud"."lappct") AS m1 FROM "scanpointcloud" JOIN "projects" ON "projects"."arcregistry" = "scanpointcloud"."arcref"  GROUP BY "scanpointcloud"."arcref", "projects"."fundflux"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v"), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m1" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: average of scan overlap per projects within projects.fundflux
gap to the all average of average of scan overlap (all level)
rank within the group by average of scan overlap, keep the top 3

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "scans"."zoneref" AS e, "sites"."guardhint" AS g, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "scans" JOIN "sites" ON "sites"."zoneregistry" = "scans"."zoneref"  GROUP BY "scans"."zoneref", "sites"."guardhint"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s1"."g" = "s2"."g"), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m2" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: share of the g total of number of scans records (g level)
rank within the group by number of scans records: share of the g total, keep the top 3
